Otherkinism deals, largely, with faith. If someone claims to be something other than human to any degree, that's generally a claim that is neither provable nor disprovable, and to accomplish one or the other should not be anyone's concern. That said, here are the rules and guidelines so that we can all have a relatively good time here:

Rule 1: Don't be a dick.

Guidelines: * You are not required to justify your identity via logic or storytelling. Instead, your presence here will be justified through your behavior. * Blatant skepticism of someone else's identity is not to be broadcast unless they fail the troll test (pending). Ask non-leading questions. * Therianthropy is welcome here. * Misanthropy is not. We need to be respectful of humans. * Multiples (tulpae, spirits) are welcome to speak here, but the use of text to denote the speaker is encouraged as opposed to bookends {such as this.} Everyone has different bookends and it can be a pain to keep track of that. * This subverse is not about you. This subverse is about US, as a community. Got an image of your kinself? Cool. Wanna share your story? Awesome. Feel the impulse to compare yourself to others and/or belittle them in favor of your own beliefs? Not cool. Don't do that. * Don't feed the trolls. * Haters gonna hate.
